title: Add a general ban on unfair trading practices to consumer law
action: Legislate Treasury's preferred option: a general, principles-based prohibition on unfair trading practices, with specific rules on subscription traps and drip pricing, alongside the unfair contract terms law.
why: Unfair contract terms law catches unfair terms but not unfair conduct, such as manipulative online design, which distorts choices and blunts competition on price and quality.

evidence.source: Unfair trading practices: Decision Regulation Impact Statement
evidence.quote: Treasury analysed the proposals and feedback from stakeholders and recommends Option 4 as the preferred policy option. This option proposes the introduction of a general principles-based prohibition on unfair trading practices into the ACL, and additional reforms to the ACL to address unfair subscription practices and drip pricing.
